name: UI Icons
description: Generic icon manager for Drupal that integrates third-party icon packs and exposes them across Drupal's display tools; ships the icon_autocomplete form element.
submodules: ui_icons_patterns: Icons integration with UI Patterns 1.x and 2.x.
ui_icons_backport: Deprecated empty placeholder; API backport for Drupal before 11.1.
ui_icons_field: Provides an Icon field type and Link field integration.
ui_icons_media: Media integration allowing icons as a media type.
ui_icons_picker: Fancy visual icon picker widget for the UI Icons selector.
ui_icons_library: Admin overview page listing all icons available on the site.
ui_icons_font: FontExtractor plugin to define icon packs from web fonts.
ui_icons_text: Text-filter integration to embed icons in filtered content.
ui_icons_menu: Menu UI integration to attach icons to menu links.
ui_icons_ckeditor5: CKEditor 5 plugin to embed icons in rich text.
ui_icons_iconify_api: Deprecated empty placeholder; replaced by the Iconify Icons module.
ui_icons_field_link_attributes: Link-with-attributes (link_attributes) integration for icon fields.
ui_icons_field_linkit: Linkit integration for icon fields.
ui_icons_field_linkit_attributes: Linkit-with-attributes integration for icon fields.
project_description:
This module leverage Drupal 11.1 Icon API which allow to define icon packs as YAML-discovered to integrate seamlessly in Drupal development and site-building with Field API (with Link attributes), CKeditor5, Menu API, Media, a Web font extractor and a library.

 After installing this module, check our repository of examples to include existing icon pack providers.

 
 Drupal compatibility 
 The 2.0.x branch is for Drupal 11.3+ 

 The 1.1.x branch is for Drupal 11.1+ and upgrade from previous version. This branch include empty backport and Iconify sub modules to be removed. Use Iconify Icons 2.0.x instead.

 
 Back to top 

 Integration with Drupal site building tools 
 Once discovered from the icon packs, the icons can be used:

 
 
 as a Field , with specific widget and formatter, to store a picked icon and render it in entity displays. 
 
 
 
 
 as a Field Formatter for Link fields. 
 
 
 in Menu links UI. 
 
 
 
 
 in Ckeditor5 , to add an icon in WYSIWYG content. 
 
 
 in Media , as a media type. 
 
 
 Feel free to propose other integrations.

 Back to top 

 Icons library 
 The UI Icons Library sub-module generates an icons library page to be used as documentation for content editors or as a showcase for business and clients.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 Back to top 

 Showcases 
 This module does not include third-party icons but makes it very simple to add existing icons from any provider or your own, and mix them together!

 Examples in contrib space:

 
 
 Bootstrap 5 
 DSFR (French Gov) 
 USWDS (US Gov)

 Back to top 

 Drupal core 
 We are willing to push part of this module to Drupal core, The Icon API was a first step, next step:

 
 Add form element(s) for Icon API 
 
 Feel free to contact me if you're willing to help.

 Back to top 

 Incompatibility 
 
 Ui Icons CKeditor5 is not compatible with ckeditor5_icons module 
 
 Back to top
